name: Breakout Strategy
market_conditions: price consolidating near a well-defined support or resistance zone
at least two or more touches of the zone establishing its validity
declining volume during consolidation indicating coiling
market not in high-noise low-structure environment
broader trend aligned with the direction of breakout for higher probability
phase_requirements: consolidation or tight range formation at key zone
entry_conditions: price closes outside the support/resistance zone on the entry timeframe
breakout candle volume is greater than 1.5 times the 20-period average volume
breakout candle body is large relative to recent candles indicating momentum
zone has been tested at least twice before the breakout
for momentum entry: enter immediately after the breakout close
for re-test entry: wait for price to pull back to the broken zone and show confirmation
confirmation_requirements: candle closes fully outside the zone, not just a wick breach
volume on breakout candle exceeds 1.5 times the average volume
next candle continues in the breakout direction or consolidates above/below zone
for re-test entry: zone acts as new support for bullish breakout or new resistance for bearish breakdown
RSI moving above 50 for bullish breakout or below 50 for bearish breakdown
stop_loss_logic: For momentum entry: stop loss inside the zone, just below the upper boundary for longs or above the lower boundary for shorts, with 0.5 ATR buffer. For re-test entry: stop below the zone's lower boundary for longs or above the upper boundary for shorts.
take_profit_logic: Measure the height of the consolidation range and project it from the breakout point. First target at 1x the range height (measured move). Second target at 1.5x or 2x range height. Trail stop after first target is reached.
invalidation_conditions: breakout candle closes back inside the zone (false breakout)
volume is below average on the breakout candle
price immediately reverses after breakout without re-testing zone
re-test of broken zone fails and price closes back inside the zone
multiple failed breakout attempts at the same zone
broader market trend opposing the breakout direction

timeframe_requirements.macro: 1D to identify the key zone and broader trend
timeframe_requirements.entry: 4H or 1H for breakout execution and volume confirmation

risk_notes: False breakouts are the primary risk; always require a candle close outside the zone. Volume confirmation is non-negotiable. Re-test entries have lower risk but may miss the move if re-test does not occur. Avoid breakouts in choppy markets or against major trend. Earnings or news events can cause false breakouts with abnormal volume — be cautious around scheduled events.

agent_rules.rule: Never enter a breakout on a wick breach alone — require a full candle close outside the zone.
Volume on the breakout candle must be at least 1.5 times the 20-period average volume; if not, wait for re-test entry.
If the breakout candle closes back inside the zone on the next candle, the trade is invalidated — exit immediately.
Measure the range height before entry and set TP1 at the measured move projection.
For re-test entries, only enter if the broken zone now holds as support/resistance — confirmed by a reversal candle.
Do not enter a breakout if the zone has already failed 3 or more times — the market is rejecting the move.
